say:0:1110501001:0.text: Ready? The first Trial of Wisdom challenge is just up ahead!
say:0:1110501001:0.source_cn: 准备好了吗？前方就是“智之试炼”的第一个关口！

say:1:1110501002:0.text: Before we officially kick off, Mikola has got a little tip for you!
say:1:1110501002:0.source_cn: 在比赛正式开始之前，曼卡拉有小小的提示！你们虽然是对手——

say:2:1110501003:0.text: In this trial, cooperation may just be the key to victory!
say:2:1110501003:0.source_cn: 但在这次的试炼中，可能“合作”才能更快取得胜利哦！

say:3:1110501004:0.text: That's all for the hints! Now let the competition begin!
say:3:1110501004:0.source_cn: 提示到此为止！那么，比赛正式开始——！

say:1:1110502001:1.text: A tightly closed door with two stone slabs in front of it...
say:1:1110502001:1.source_cn: 一扇紧闭的门，门前有两块石板……

say:2:1110502002:1.text: Hmm... These slabs look like they could be pressed down with something heavy. Should we try standing on them?
say:2:1110502002:1.source_cn: 石板的边缘微微高出地面，看起来能被重物压下去……我们站...

say:4:1110502004:1.text: Nothing happened, you worrywart! But I have an idea.
say:4:1110502004:1.source_cn: 看，无事发生！不过站上去之后，确实能感到石板下有升降机关……

say:5:1110502005:1.text: Seth, I know we're competitors, but would you stand on the other slab for a second?
say:5:1110502005:1.source_cn: 赛特斯大人，虽然是对手——不过，能请您站到另一块石板上去吗？

say:8:1110502006:1.text: Don't tell me what to do.

say:9:1110502007:1.text: I'm not! I'm just saying, Mikola hinted that teamwork might be the ticket here. It wouldn't hurt to try, right?
say:9:1110502007:1.source_cn: 我并不想，也无法强迫您。只是，曼卡拉提示要我们双方合作...

choice_prompt:10:1110502007.text: I'm not! I'm just saying, Mikola hinted that teamwork might be the ticket here. It wouldn't hurt to try, right?
choice_prompt:10:1110502007.source_cn: 我并不想，也无法强迫您。只是，曼卡拉提示要我们双方合作才能通过试炼，尝试一次，对您也没什么损失吧？

say:11:1110502008:1.text: I trust Alsa's instincts in situations like this. I hope you will too.
say:11:1110502008:1.source_cn: 我赞成阿尔萨的判断。每当这种时候，她的直觉都值得信赖。

say:12:1110502010:1.text: Trust you? Dream on. We're rivals right now.
say:12:1110502010:1.source_cn: 要我信任你们？别异想天开了。我们可是对手——

say:13:1110502011:1.text: What my years in battle have taught me is that you never do what your enemy expects.
say:13:1110502011:1.source_cn: 多年的战斗教会我什么，那就是——绝不要做敌人希望你做的事。

say:14:1110502012:1.text: I'll find another way. Good luck, I'll see you at the finish line.
say:14:1110502012:1.source_cn: 我会另寻出路。你们，自求多福吧。

say:16:1110502009:1.text: True, but it's just the first hurdle. If Mikola's hint is true, we should trust Alsa's judgment.
say:16:1110502009:1.source_cn: 的确，但这只是第一道关口，如果曼卡拉的提示不是误导，我...

say:1:1110503002:0.text: Hm, let me try standing on it... Ah, that didn't work.
say:1:1110503002:0.source_cn: 我去另一边试试……好像没有触发机关。

say:2:1110503003:0.text: It seems we won't be able to solve this puzzle. Let's try to find another route.
say:2:1110503003:0.source_cn: 看来，这扇门开启的条件并不是重量。只能放弃解开这扇门，...
say:2:1110503003:0.male: It seems we won't be able to solve this puzzle. Let's try to find another route.
say:2:1110503003:0.female: It seems we won't be able to solve this puzzle. Let's try to find another route.

say:0:1110504001:0.text: That door ahead is guarded by monsters. Prepare yourself.
say:0:1110504001:0.source_cn: 送我们进来的门被关上了。前方的另一扇门有怪物看守，看来...

say:1:1110504002:0.text: Soren, don't rush in like that! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you think something's off?
say:1:1110504002:0.source_cn: 索恩，先别急着上！这里有些奇怪，<style=stre...
say:1:1110504002:0.male: Soren, don't rush in like that! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you think something's off?
say:1:1110504002:0.female: Soren, don't rush in like that! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you think something's off?

say:2:1110504003:0.text: Since it's the Trial of Wisdom, it's better to strategize before battles.
say:2:1110504003:0.source_cn: 既然是“智之试炼”，战斗时注意策略会比较好。我们一起。
say:2:1110504003:0.male: Since it's the Trial of Wisdom, it's better to strategize before battles.
say:2:1110504003:0.female: Since it's the Trial of Wisdom, it's better to strategize before battles.

say:1:1110505002:0.text: No worries. The portal's activated, let's keep moving.
say:1:1110505002:0.source_cn: 不客气，传送门启动了，我们继续前进吧。
say:1:1110505002:0.male: No worries. The portal's activated, let's keep moving.
say:1:1110505002:0.female: No worries. The portal's activated, let's keep moving.

say:1:1110506001:1.text: It seems you guys have also passed the previous checkpoint.
say:1:1110506001:1.source_cn: 看来，你们也通过了刚才那一关。

say:3:1110506002:1.text: Nice to see you again, Seth! Looks like the winner of the Trial of Wisdom won't be decided so easily!
say:3:1110506002:1.source_cn: 又见面了，赛特斯大人！看来“智之试炼”的胜者还没那么容...

say:4:1110506003:1.text: Ha! If it was a race, you'd be toast by now.
say:4:1110506003:1.source_cn: 可笑。如果这是竞速淘汰，你们早已输了。

say:5:1110506004:1.text: Even working together as a group, you're all slower than me. What use is that teamwork of yours now, huh?
say:5:1110506004:1.source_cn: 一群乌合之众，过关的速度竟还不如我一个人。你们引以为傲...

say:7:1110506005:1.text: Being fast on your feet doesn't prove much.
say:7:1110506005:1.source_cn: 腿脚快些，也说明不了什么。

say:8:1110506006:1.text: Big words, pal. I hope your fists talk more than your mouth does.
say:8:1110506006:1.source_cn: 呵，嘴硬。希望你的拳头比嘴更硬。

say:9:1110506007:1.text: Let's continue. You should pray to the gods above that the next challenge doesn't require us to cross swords!
say:9:1110506007:1.source_cn: 继续前进吧。你们应当向残阳神祷告，下一关不必与我白刃相向！

say:0:1110507001:0.text: Are these puzzles related to the portals?
say:0:1110507001:0.source_cn: 这地上的谜题，与传送门有关吗？

say:1:1110507002:0.text: It seems so. Let's try to solve them.
say:1:1110507002:0.male: It seems so. Let's try to solve them.
say:1:1110507002:0.female: It seems so. Let's try to solve them.

say:1:1110508002:0.text: The second gate has also been activated. Let's go.
say:1:1110508002:0.source_cn: 第二道门也启动了，走吧。
say:1:1110508002:0.male: The second gate has also been activated. Let's go.
say:1:1110508002:0.female: The second gate has also been activated. Let's go.

say:1:1110510001:1.text: Are you ready to face the final trial?
say:1:1110510001:1.source_cn: 你们准备好迎接最后的试炼了吗？

say:2:1110510002:1.text: Entrusted by the ancient will, I bring three riddles for you to solve before you may move forward.
say:2:1110510002:1.source_cn: 我受古老的意志所托，为诸位带来三道谜题，猜出谜底方可前进。

say:6:1110510005:1.text: I grow stronger with time and experience. The more challenges I face, the more of me you gain. As I age, I become stronger. What am I?
say:6:1110510005:1.source_cn: 我随时间和经验而增长，我遇到的挑战越多，你获得我的部分...

choice_prompt:7:1110510005.text: I grow stronger with time and experience. The more challenges I face, the more of me you gain. As I age, I become stronger. What am I?
choice_prompt:7:1110510005.source_cn: 我随时间和经验而增长，我遇到的挑战越多，你获得我的部分就越多。随着年龄的增长，我会变得更强大，我是什么？

say:8:1110510006:1.text: Hmm... But strength doesn't really grow with age, right? I think it's wisdom!
say:8:1110510006:1.source_cn: 力量不会随着年龄的增长而强大吧？我猜，应该是智慧！

say:9:1110510008:1.text: Wisdom Keeper, what do you think? Did we guess right?
say:9:1110510008:1.source_cn: 英灵前辈，如何？猜对了吗？

say:10:1110510009:1.text: That is correct. Now, for the second riddle.
say:10:1110510009:1.source_cn: 正确无误。那么，第二道谜题——

say:11:1110510010:1.text: Sand grains scatter in the wind, but the desert as a whole remains untouched. Why is that?
say:11:1110510010:1.source_cn: 单独的沙粒随风而散，整个的沙漠却不为风所动摇，这是因为什么？

choice_prompt:12:1110510010.text: Sand grains scatter in the wind, but the desert as a whole remains untouched. Why is that?
choice_prompt:12:1110510010.source_cn: 单独的沙粒随风而散，整个的沙漠却不为风所动摇，这是因为什么？

say:13:1110510011:1.text: Although a strong will is important, I don't think that's the correct answer...
say:13:1110510011:1.source_cn: 虽然也很重要啦，但感觉更像是团结合作？

say:14:1110510013:1.text: So did we get it right?
say:14:1110510013:1.source_cn: 第二道题，我们答对了吗？

say:15:1110510014:1.text: Correct. Just like how sand is unmovable as a whole unit, unity and cooperation are vital for the survival for Maulers in the harsh desert.
say:15:1110510014:1.source_cn: 正确无误。团结合作正是蛮血在这残酷沙漠中生存的唯一要义。

say:16:1110510015:1.text: That is also what the Warsong Festival stands for, avoiding pointless internal strife and bloodshed...
say:16:1110510015:1.source_cn: 这也是战歌节的初衷，远离无谓的内斗和流血……

say:17:1110510016:1.text: I perished in the turmoil of war long ago. I hope that my blood and tears serve as a warning to others.
say:17:1110510016:1.source_cn: 我殒命于多年前的倾轧鏖战，希望我之血泪足以警世。

say:20:1110510018:1.source_cn: 试炼者们，现在还剩下最后一道谜题——

say:21:1110510019:1.text: I await in the center of a trap I set. Poisonous bites and sharp thorns instill fear in my prey, while my eight eyes observe their hurried movements. What am I?
say:21:1110510019:1.source_cn: 我布下天罗地网，端坐在中央。毒咬和尖刺使猎物畏惧，八只...

choice_prompt:22:1110510019.text: I await in the center of a trap I set. Poisonous bites and sharp thorns instill fear in my prey, while my eight eyes observe their hurried movements. What am I?
choice_prompt:22:1110510019.source_cn: 我布下天罗地网，端坐在中央。毒咬和尖刺使猎物畏惧，八只眼睛窥视着他们急行。我是什么？

say:23:1110510020:1.text: Yes, it's gotta be a spider! It's so obvious!
say:23:1110510020:1.source_cn: 对啊，谜底肯定是蜘蛛！太明显了！

say:24:1110510022:1.text: Simple? Challengers, let's not jump to conclusions.
say:24:1110510022:1.source_cn: 简单？试炼者，切勿言之过早。

say:26:1110510023:1.text: Hmph. Does this riddle lead to a battle in the end?
say:26:1110510023:1.source_cn: 哼，无聊的谜题最后导向的还是战斗吗？

say:27:1110510024:1.text: If we were going to fight anyway, I would've rather we skipped the riddles and just got down to it.
say:27:1110510024:1.source_cn: 那不如直接进行战斗，省去无谓的过程。

say:29:1110510021:1.text: Yeah, even I could figure it out! That was so simple!
say:29:1110510021:1.source_cn: 没错，我都能猜出来……居然这么容易的吗？

choice:22:1:2.text: Isn't this riddle way too easy?
choice:22:1:2.male: Isn't this riddle way too easy?
choice:22:1:2.female: Isn't this riddle way too easy?

say:30:1110510012:1.text: Hm? I don't think that's the right answer, I think it must be about cooperation!
say:30:1110510012:1.source_cn: 嗯？好像不太对，我猜是团结合作！

choice:12:2:3.text: Sand just goes with the flow.
choice:12:2:3.male: Sand just goes with the flow.
choice:12:2:3.female: Sand just goes with the flow.

say:31:1110510007:1.text: Hmm... But glory only comes with consistent victories. I think the answer is wisdom!
say:31:1110510007:1.source_cn: 得一直胜利了才会不断获得吧？看起来，只有智慧了。

say:1:1110516001:1.text: Congratulations on using wisdom and cooperation to defeat those spiders.
say:1:1110516001:1.source_cn: 恭喜诸位运用智慧和团结合作，击败了那些蜘蛛。

say:2:1110516002:1.text: Please go through this door and collect your prize.
say:2:1110516002:1.source_cn: 请进入这扇大门，收下属于你们的信物。

say:6:1110516004:1.text: That's not important. You should go and claim the prize.

say:10:1110516006:1.text: Admitting defeat isn't weakness, it's respecting the rules.
say:10:1110516006:1.source_cn: 这次的胜利者是你们，自然该你们拿到战利品。

say:11:1110516007:1.text: I admit you deserve this win. To the victors go the spoils.
say:11:1110516007:1.source_cn: 认输并非懦弱，而是对规则的尊重。我尊重结果。

say:12:1110516008:1.text: The path of the brave, though different, leads to the same destination. Those who seek battle... will eventually meet again somewhere.
say:12:1110516008:1.source_cn: 勇者之道，殊途同归。追求战斗的强者……终会在某处再见。

choice_prompt:14:1110516008.text: The path of the brave, though different, leads to the same destination. Those who seek battle... will eventually meet again somewhere.
choice_prompt:14:1110516008.source_cn: 勇者之道，殊途同归。追求战斗的强者……终会在某处再见。

say:16:1110516010:1.text: My feelings towards him suddenly became complicated...
say:16:1110516010:1.source_cn: 我对赛特斯大人的心情突然复杂起来了……

say:17:1110516011:1.text: Indeed. I was ready to fight him again.
say:17:1110516011:1.source_cn: 真是意外。我本来都做好跟他再打一架的准备了。

say:18:1110516012:1.text: Me too, that was unexpected! Anyways, let's go get the prize!
say:18:1110516012:1.source_cn: 我也是，真没想到。不想了，去拿信物咯！

choice:14:1:2.text: With deep words to think on...
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 留下很帅的话后走掉了……
choice:14:1:2.male: With deep words to think on...
choice:14:1:2.female: With deep words to think on...

say:0:1110517001:0.source_cn: 这就是“战神项链”吗？胜者的信物果然只有一个。

say:1:1110517002:0.text: It's so exquisite! I wanna try it on!

say:2:1110517003:0.text: Come on, let's hurry back to the camp and hand it to Mikola.
say:2:1110517003:0.source_cn: 不给。快回到战歌营帐，将信物交给曼卡拉吧。

say:1:1110518001:1.text: Wow! You guys came back safely!
say:1:1110518001:1.source_cn: 真高兴！我就知道会再次见到你们！

say:2:1110518002:1.text: Everyone, let's give some warm applause to these two brave warriors from the Uru Clan! They triumphantly returned after completing the <style="highlight">Trial of Wisdom</style> with the Huntsman's Necklace!
say:2:1110518002:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的朋友们，最热烈的掌声送给乌尔氏族的两位勇士！他...

say:3:1110518003:1.text: We are witnessing an unprecedented miracle in the history of the Warsong Festival!
say:3:1110518003:1.source_cn: 我要提醒诸位的是，我们正在见证战歌节历史上前所未有的奇迹！

say:4:1110518004:1.text: Participating for the first time at such a young age! And the fact that they've actually secured a spot in the official Warsong Festival!
say:4:1110518004:1.source_cn: 初次参与试炼！并且还是如此年轻的参赛者！一举拿下战歌节...

say:6:1110518005:0.text: The chance to participate in the Warsong Festival... This feels like a dream come true.
say:6:1110518005:0.source_cn: 呜哇，太好了……居然能正式参与战歌节，真的像做梦一样……

say:8:1110518006:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.
say:8:1110518006:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.
say:8:1110518006:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.

choice_prompt:9:1110518006.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.
choice_prompt:9:1110518006.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，谢谢你。那天阿尔萨能遇到你，是我们的幸运。
choice_prompt:9:1110518006.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.
choice_prompt:9:1110518006.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.

say:10:1110518007:1.text: Don't be so modest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We really couldn't have gotten here without you.
say:10:1110518007:1.male: Don't be so modest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We really couldn't have gotten here without you.
say:10:1110518007:1.female: Don't be so modest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We really couldn't have gotten here without you.

say:11:1110518009:1.text: Hey y'all! There's still some time before the official preliminaries start.
say:11:1110518009:1.source_cn: 锵锵！离正式的初赛还有段时间，曼卡拉要要开始正式的忙碌...

say:12:1110518010:1.text: What are your plans? Are you going to go celebrate?
say:12:1110518010:1.source_cn: 你们有什么计划？要用来庆祝吗？

say:13:1110518011:1.text: Maybe! I'm thinking about going back to the Uru Clan to visit everyone. I miss them so much!
say:13:1110518011:1.source_cn: 或许吧！我也有点想回乌尔氏族看看，好想念氏族的大家！

say:14:1110518012:1.text: Rather than celebrating, I think we should use this time to recharge. After all, in the official matches, we'll face completely different opponents.
say:14:1110518012:1.source_cn: 比起庆祝，更该用这段时间养精蓄锐。毕竟在正式赛中，我们...

say:15:1110518013:1.source_cn: 没错，要的就是这个精神！

say:16:1110518014:1.text: Will the young Soren and Alsa make it to the finals and stand atop the Mars Peak? Let's wait and see!
say:16:1110518014:1.source_cn: 年轻的索恩和阿尔萨，能否闯进决赛，屹立在战神峰顶？让我...

say:18:1110518008:1.text: I remember you're hoping to get to Mars Peak. Alsa and I will work hard to make it to the finals!
say:18:1110518008:1.source_cn: 我记得你的目的地是战神峰。我和阿尔萨会努力进入决赛的。
say:18:1110518008:1.male: I remember you're hoping to get to Mars Peak. Alsa and I will work hard to make it to the finals!
say:18:1110518008:1.female: I remember you're hoping to get to Mars Peak. Alsa and I will work hard to make it to the finals!

choice:9:1:2.text: Couldn't have done it without me!
choice:9:1:2.male: Couldn't have done it without me!
choice:9:1:2.female: Couldn't have done it without me!

say:0:1110519001:0.text: The Uru Clan has finally been recognized! I can't wait to tell father!
say:0:1110519001:0.source_cn: 乌尔氏族终于被认可了！真想快点告诉老爹！

say:1:1110519002:0.text: Now more and more people will want to join our clan! I wonder if more people means more decadent meals... *Giggle*
say:1:1110519002:0.source_cn: 现在，一定有很多人想要加入乌尔氏族吧！我该怎么喂饱越来...

say:2:1110519003:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, got any magic to cure this dodo's daydreaming?
say:2:1110519003:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, got any magic to cure this dodo's daydreaming?
say:2:1110519003:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, got any magic to cure this dodo's daydreaming?

say:7:1110521004:1.text: There's something off about this dagger. Alsa's burning up...
say:7:1110521004:1.source_cn: 这把匕首可能有问题，阿尔萨的身体好烫……

say:8:1110521005:1.text: Could there be poison on it? What do we do?! Alsa!!

say:9:1110521006:1.text: Soren, calm down! Keep your wits about you.
say:9:1110521006:1.source_cn: 索恩，你冷静点！现在最要紧的是救阿尔萨！

say:10:1110521007:1.text: Little one, do you know what's on this dagger?
say:10:1110521007:1.source_cn: 那个小蛮血，你知道这把匕首上涂的是什么毒药吗？

say:12:1110521008:1.text: I'm so sorry... I had no choice! I had to do this for my sister! That merchant guy told me to and...
say:12:1110521008:1.source_cn: 毒药？我不知道……只、只是有个商人叔叔找到我，给我食物...

say:14:1110521010:1.text: I don't know, he wasn't a Mauler. Maybe he was just visiting?
say:14:1110521010:1.source_cn: 我不知道……那个商人叔叔不是蛮血，可能走掉了吧？

choice_prompt:16:1110521010.text: I don't know, he wasn't a Mauler. Maybe he was just visiting?
choice_prompt:16:1110521010.source_cn: 我不知道……那个商人叔叔不是蛮血，可能走掉了吧？

say:18:1110521011:1.text: Perhaps... a merchant from the Adamant Syndicate? This kind of foul thing definitely seems like something they'd do!
say:18:1110521011:1.source_cn: 主人是想起了……黑金商会？这种暗中搞事的感觉，确实很像！
say:18:1110521011:1.male: Perhaps... a merchant from the Adamant Syndicate? This kind of foul thing definitely seems like something they'd do!
say:18:1110521011:1.female: Perhaps... a merchant from the Adamant Syndicate? This kind of foul thing definitely seems like something they'd do!

say:20:1110521013:1.text: But if it was them, why would they target Alsa? It doesn't make sense...
say:20:1110521013:1.source_cn: 不过如果真的是黑金商会，他们为什么会盯上阿尔萨？好奇怪啊……

say:22:1110521014:1.source_cn: 你们说的黑金商会，是什么意思？

say:23:1110521015:1.text: A group full of evil people! They're all a bunch of bad eggs! And if it really is them behind this... Finding the antidote won't be easy...
say:23:1110521015:1.source_cn: 就是一个坏蛋组织！如果真的是黑金商会，那么解药肯定很难...

say:24:1110521016:1.text: I understand... But what do we do about this kid?
say:24:1110521016:1.source_cn: 我明白了。看来你也没有解药，对吗？

say:26:1110521017:1.text: I'm sorry... I just wanted to help my sister. Please forgive me!
say:26:1110521017:1.source_cn: 对不起，大哥哥，我太饿了……

say:28:1110521019:1.text: Never show your face here again!
say:28:1110521019:1.source_cn: 我不是阿尔萨。不想吃苦头的话，之后就别出现在我面前！

say:30:1110521020:1.text: By the setting sun! Alsa's injured? Take her to that tent to rest...
say:30:1110521020:1.source_cn: 残阳神啊！阿尔萨这是受伤了吗？快带她去那顶帐篷里休息……

say:33:1110521022:1.source_cn: 都怪我……阿尔萨，真的不会出事吗？

say:34:1110521023:1.text: Poisoned? Maybe we can find a cure... Ah! Wait a second!
say:34:1110521023:1.source_cn: 中毒吗？或许能找到办法……等我！

say:37:1110521012:1.text: From the Adamant Syndicate?! Speaking of which, I do remember seeing their goons lurking around here...
say:37:1110521012:1.source_cn: 是黑金商会？！说起来，之前确实在这附近看到了他们的人……
say:37:1110521012:1.male: From the Adamant Syndicate?! Speaking of which, I do remember seeing their goons lurking around here...
say:37:1110521012:1.female: From the Adamant Syndicate?! Speaking of which, I do remember seeing their goons lurking around here...

say:0:1110522001:0.text: Her temperature is so high. Can we find some ice to cool her down?
say:0:1110522001:0.source_cn: 阿尔萨……身体好热。能找到冰块为她降温吗？
say:0:1110522001:0.male: Her temperature is so high. Can we find some ice to cool her down?
say:0:1110522001:0.female: Her temperature is so high. Can we find some ice to cool her down?

say:1:1110522002:0.text: In the desert? I think that might be difficult.
say:1:1110522002:0.source_cn: 在沙漠里找冰块？你是想要个冰魔法吗？
say:1:1110522002:0.male: In the desert? I think that might be difficult.
say:1:1110522002:0.female: In the desert? I think that might be difficult.

say:2:1110522003:0.text: Ugh... If our positions were reversed, I know she'd find a solution in an instant...
say:2:1110522003:0.source_cn: 大概……是吧。抱歉，如果倒下的是我，她一定能找到办法的……
say:2:1110522003:0.male: Ugh... If our positions were reversed, I know she'd find a solution in an instant...
say:2:1110522003:0.female: Ugh... If our positions were reversed, I know she'd find a solution in an instant...

say:0:1110523001:0.text: Hey! This guy should be able to help!

say:2:1110524002:1.text: Hmm... From her symptoms and the residue on the dagger—
say:2:1110524002:1.source_cn: 唔……从阿尔萨的症状和匕首上残余毒药的色泽判断——

say:3:1110524003:1.text: It indeed is the specific poison I suspected.
say:3:1110524003:1.source_cn: 错不了，确实是我想的那种毒药。

say:5:1110524004:1.text: Well? Stop being mysterious and just tell us! Can you make an antidote?!
say:5:1110524004:1.source_cn: 喂！你在将功补过，别卖关子了！你能配出解药吗？

say:8:1110524006:1.text: Hey, your eyes are giving off a bit of a scary vibe... So, it's like this:
say:8:1110524006:1.source_cn: 呃！你们的眼神不要这么恐怖！是这样的……

say:9:1110524007:1.text: I have a formula for the antidote, but we're missing a crucial herb.
say:9:1110524007:1.source_cn: 解药的配方我大致有头绪，不过缺少了一种关键的草药！

say:10:1110524008:1.text: The herb is called luminous sandweed, and there's only one place to find it. Can you guess where?
say:10:1110524008:1.source_cn: 那种草药叫曜砂草，只有一个渠道能搞到，你们猜猜是哪里——

choice_prompt:11:1110524008.text: The herb is called luminous sandweed, and there's only one place to find it. Can you guess where?
choice_prompt:11:1110524008.source_cn: 那种草药叫曜砂草，只有一个渠道能搞到，你们猜猜是哪里——

say:12:1110524009:1.text: I didn't mean to sound so mysterious! I've just been telling so many bedtime stories to the kids that it became a habit.
say:12:1110524009:1.source_cn: 我、我真的不是有意的！唉，都是给孩子们讲太多睡前故事，...

say:13:1110524010:1.text: I only know one merchant, Benji, who deals with this herb. He can usually be found around the Sunseek Arena.
say:13:1110524010:1.source_cn: 我只认识一个草药商——班吉能提供这种草药，他平时在残阳...

say:14:1110524011:1.text: The Sunseek Arena is so far away! If we take the same detour we did from the Grimmaw camp as we did on the way here, we definitely won't make it in time...
say:14:1110524011:1.source_cn: 从战歌营帐去残阳武斗场？如果像来的时候那样从黑嚎营地绕...

say:15:1110524012:1.text: It's life or death, we can't waste any time. No detours, Soren...
say:15:1110524012:1.source_cn: 人命关天，片刻都不能耽误。不必绕路了，索恩……

say:16:1110524013:0.text: Here's a note! You can use this to access the back entrance of the arena.
say:16:1110524013:0.source_cn: 我会给你们一份手书，让你们可以从武斗场的后门通过！

say:19:1110524015:1.text: You should head out. I'll stay here and keep an eye on Alsa.
say:19:1110524015:1.source_cn: 快出发吧，我跟这个家伙帮你照顾阿尔萨！

say:20:1110524016:1.text: I'll be back as soon as possible!
say:20:1110524016:1.source_cn: 拜托了！我会尽快返回的！

say:21:1110524017:1.text: Take good care of her. If anything happens to her—
say:21:1110524017:1.source_cn: 好好照顾阿尔萨，如果阿尔萨出了什么问题——

say:22:1110524018:1.text: ... Huh? How did she suddenly become my responsibility?
say:22:1110524018:1.source_cn: 诶？怎么就成了我的责任？

choice:7:0:1.text: What do you mean by yes?
choice:7:0:1.male: What do you mean by yes?
choice:7:0:1.female: What do you mean by yes?

choice:7:1:2.text: What do you mean by no?
choice:7:1:2.male: What do you mean by no?
choice:7:1:2.female: What do you mean by no?

say:0:1110525001:0.source_cn: 原来如此，曼卡拉大人写得很清楚了。

say:1:1110525002:0.text: You may pass. I wish your friend a speedy recovery!
say:1:1110525002:0.source_cn: 你们快点进去吧，祝你们的朋友早日恢复健康！

say:1:1110526001:1.text: Hey there! Lookin' for some herbs?
say:1:1110526001:1.source_cn: 客人们，有什么药材需求吗？

say:3:1110526002:1.text: Smokey told us that you have luminous sandweed in stock.
say:3:1110526002:1.source_cn: 阿熏让我们来的，说你有曜砂草。

say:4:1110526003:1.text: Huh? He's asking for that herb again?

say:5:1110526004:1.text: No way! This is the last of my stock. I won't part with it until a new shipment comes in!
say:5:1110526004:1.source_cn: 绝对不行！这是我压箱底的库存，在有新货进来之前，绝不会脱手！

say:6:1110526005:1.text: Please sell it to us! Someone's life is at stake!
say:6:1110526005:1.source_cn: 请务必让给我们，现在人命关天。

say:7:1110526006:1.text: So what? People die every day in the Ashen Wastes. If you want the herb, you better give me a better reason!
say:7:1110526006:1.source_cn: 所以呢？荒角沙漠每天都在出人命。想要草药，你得给我更好...

say:10:1110526008:1.text: My dear sister Alsa has been poisoned. She won't live another day without an antidote made with the herb.
say:10:1110526008:1.source_cn: ……我的妹妹阿尔萨中毒了，她急需曜砂草救命。

say:11:1110526009:1.text: I'm begging you, I just need a bit...

say:12:1110526012:1.text: If that's the case... Take this. May the gods bless her with a speedy recovery.
say:12:1110526012:1.source_cn: 既然这样……这些曜砂草，你拿走吧。残阳神保佑，祝她早日康复。

say:14:1110526010:1.text: I am Soren from the Uru Clan, a participant in the Warsong Festival.
say:14:1110526010:1.source_cn: 我是乌尔氏族的索恩，本次战歌节的参赛者。我保证——

say:15:1110526011:1.text: I swear on my honor that if you sell me some of this herb today, I'll repay you tenfold after the festival ends!
say:15:1110526011:1.source_cn: 今日你给我这些草药，战歌节结束后，我十倍奉还！

say:0:1110527001:0.source_cn: 快回去吧，阿尔萨还在等着我们。

say:1:1110527002:0.text: Thank you so much for your help during this time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:1:1110527002:0.source_cn: ……我不知道该说什么了。谢谢你，<style=stre...
say:1:1110527002:0.male: Thank you so much for your help during this time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:1:1110527002:0.female: Thank you so much for your help during this time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:0:1110528001:0.text: Phew, you guys made it back on time! Alsa's condition hasn't changed.
say:0:1110528001:0.source_cn: 呼，你们及时回来了！阿尔萨的状况没有恶化！

say:1:1110528002:0.text: Here's the luminous sandweed you asked for. Please make the antidote quickly.
say:1:1110528002:0.source_cn: 这是你要的曜砂草。快点做解药吧。

say:2:1110528003:0.text: Great! Let's start now. Can someone give me a hand?
say:2:1110528003:0.source_cn: 搞到了？太好了！那我现在就开始，来个人给我搭把手吧。

say:0:1110529001:0.text: Grind, extract the juice, dry it, add it, stir... Voila!
say:0:1110529001:0.source_cn: 磨碎，挤出汁水，烘干，投入，搅拌——

say:1:1110529002:0.text: The final step is done! Quickly, feed this to her.
say:1:1110529002:0.source_cn: 最后一步完成！快让阿尔萨喝药吧！

narration:0:1110529101:0.source_cn: 索恩喂阿尔萨吃下了药

say:5:1110530005:1.text: Someone used a poisoned dagger on you. Smokey made an antidote, but it'll take some time to fully take effect.
say:5:1110530005:1.source_cn: 有个小蛮血用涂毒的匕首刺伤了你。阿熏配出了解药，不过完...

say:7:1110530007:1.text: Don't you worry about that! Your only job now is to rest properly!
say:7:1110530007:1.source_cn: 别管这些！你现在的任务就是好好休息！

say:8:1110530008:1.text: It won't delay the preliminaries of the Warsong Festival, right?
say:8:1110530008:1.source_cn: 不会耽误……战歌节初赛吧？

choice_prompt:9:1110530008.text: It won't delay the preliminaries of the Warsong Festival, right?
choice_prompt:9:1110530008.source_cn: 不会耽误……战歌节初赛吧？

say:11:1110530010:1.text: After all, Soren and I can't afford to give up at a time like this, right?
say:11:1110530010:1.source_cn: 毕竟我和索恩——可不能在这个关头提前认输啊！对吧？

say:12:1110530011:1.text: Of course. On the day of the preliminaries, I'll carry you to the arena myself if I have to.
say:12:1110530011:1.source_cn: 呵……当然。初赛那天，我拎也要把你拎到赛场。

say:13:1110530012:1.text: Jeez, Soren! Spare me the theatrics!
say:13:1110530012:1.source_cn: 啊——不要不要！索恩大人饶命啊！

say:15:1110530013:1.text: Um, Lady Mikola, about the potions I had earlier...
say:15:1110530013:1.source_cn: 那个，曼卡拉大人，关于我之前那些个小饮料的小小问题……

say:16:1110530014:1.text: If you promise not to do it again, I'll let it slide this time. But if I hear of any future digressions... there will be consequences!
say:16:1110530014:1.source_cn: 你保证不再犯，我这次就放过你。若敢再犯，数罪并罚！

say:18:1110530016:1.text: Consider it a small act of leniency. After all, you did save an important participant of the Warsong Festival!
say:18:1110530016:1.source_cn: 就当是曼卡拉的小小宽宥吧。你可是救了战歌节重要的参赛者！

say:0:1110531001:0.text: I hope I get well soon...

narration:0:1110601001:0.text: A few days later, the Warsong Festival begins.

subtitle:1:1110520002:.text: I-I've been expelled from my clan. I heard...
subtitle:1:1110520002:.source_cn: 我，我被氏族驱逐了，听说……

subtitle:1:1110520003:.text: The Uru Clan has been taking in wanderers. I wondered...
subtitle:1:1110520003:.source_cn: 乌尔氏族会收留流浪的小蛮血，

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110511001:.source_cn: 区区蜘蛛，放在最后一环吗？
